[34mInvestigated:[0m The primary session grepped `src`, `docs`, and `README.md` for `cleanDoubleSlashes` and `respectQueryAndFragment`. It read `src/utils.ts` around the trailing-slash helpers and `cleanDoubleSlashes`, and inspected the README section and the existing `test/double-slash.test.ts` table-driven suite.

[33mLearned:[0m The trailing-slash helpers (`hasTrailingSlash`, `withoutTrailingSlash`, `withTrailingSlash`) already accept `respectQueryAndFragment` and split off the query and fragment before editing. `cleanDoubleSlashes` had no such option. It splits on `://` and collapses every slash run in each segment, so `//` inside a query such as `?redirect=//baz` gets collapsed. That is the source of the redirect-target bug.

[32mCompleted:[0m `cleanDoubleSlashes(input, respectQueryAndFragment?)` is implemented in `src/utils.ts`. With `true`, it cleans only the part before the first `?` or `#` and reattaches the rest unchanged. The JSDoc and the README entry were updated to describe the flag. Seven opt-in test cases and one default-behaviour test were added to `test/double-slash.test.ts`. `vitest` passes all 13 tests in that file, and `tsc --noEmit` printed no errors. Changes are not committed.

[35mNext Steps:[0m Nothing is in progress. The remaining open item is running the wider test suite beyond `test/double-slash.test.ts`, which has not been done yet.

[36mNotes:[0m The edits to `src/utils.ts` and the README were applied with Python string replacement, which fails silently on a non-matching pattern. The passing test run is what confirms the new branch is actually in place. Prettier was also run on `src/utils.ts` and the test file, so formatting changes outside the functional edit are possible.
